en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, and someone else from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ayoub Bin Nuh, from Al Abbas Bin Aamir, from Dawood Bin Al Husayn Mansour who said,
‘I asked about (bartering) the sheep with two sheeps, and the egg with two eggs. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem for as long as there does not happen to be a measurement of a weighing’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya and others have narrated from Muhammad Ahmad from Ayyub ibn Nuh from al-‘ Abbas ibn ‘Amir from Dawud ibn al-Husayn from Mansur who has said the following: “
I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about exchange of one sheep for two sheep, one egg for two eggs. He (the Imam) said, ’It is not harmful as long as it is not in measures and weighing.’”
